learningObjective: Distinguish rewrite-based (declarative) pattern matching from ad-hoc peephole optimization.

canonicalClaims.claim: Peephole optimization operates on a small local instruction window (target-specific, late in the pipeline); pattern rewriting frameworks apply declarative rewrite rules more broadly with framework-managed matching, and both share the pattern-to-replacement model but differ in expressiveness and pipeline position.
conditions: Both operate on transformation-safe patterns preserving semantics.
Rewrite frameworks provide fixpoint/iteration control; peephole typically runs once or in a bounded loop.
nonImplications: Does not imply rewrite frameworks replace peephole; target-specific peephole is still useful late in codegen.
Does not imply either technique is automatically terminating; rule design must avoid cycles.

misconceptions.claim: Peephole optimization is guaranteed to terminate.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Peephole is only guaranteed to terminate if rules strictly decrease some complexity measure or the framework enforces an iteration bound; cyclic rules can loop.

misconceptions.claim: Rewrite frameworks and peephole optimizers are completely unrelated concepts.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Both apply pattern-to-replacement transformations; they differ in scope, expressiveness, and pipeline position rather than in core concept.

misconceptions.claim: LLVM InstCombine is a strict peephole optimizer (pure local rewrites only).
misconceptions.whyWrong: InstCombine operates on LLVM IR with more context than classical peephole (e.g., uses def-use graph, analysis results); it sits between peephole and full rewrite framework.

implementationFacts: MLIR provides PDL (Pattern Descriptor Language) and DRR (Declarative Rewrite Rules) for declarative rewriting.
TVM Relax and Ansor use rewrite rules for tensor-level transformations.
Late-backend peephole in LLVM (X86, ARM) handles target-specific fixups.
performanceScenarios: Combining multiple micro-optimizations via a rewrite framework preserves compositionality; peephole handles final target-specific fixups.
